RCT of nortriptyline (tricyclic) vs placebo in adolescents aged 12‑17 with major depression. Oral route implied (no intravenous mentioned).
Narrative review; not a randomised controlled trial.

Randomised crossover trial of oral amitriptyline (tricyclic) vs placebo in children aged 9‑12 with MDD.
This is a Cochrane review/meta‑analysis, not an original RCT.
RCT of oral imipramine (tricyclic) + CBT vs placebo + CBT in adolescents with comorbid major depression and anxiety. Participants are depressed individuals aged ~6‑18.

Three‑arm RCT comparing paroxetine, imipramine (tricyclic), and placebo in adolescents with major depression. The imipramine‑vs‑placebo component meets all criteria.
Narrative review article on pharmacology; not an RCT.
Review of case reports/safety data; not an RCT.
Methodological paper on meta‑analysis statistics; not a clinical trial.
Retrospective case series of tricyclic poisoning; not an RCT of efficacy.
Secondary analysis of predictors of response; does not compare tricyclic vs placebo in a new randomised design.

Review/commentary; not an original RCT.

Poison control case series of accidental ingestions; not an RCT.
RCT of oral amitriptyline (tricyclic) vs placebo in adolescents aged 12‑17 with MDD.
